text:
Warm hello dear colleagues,
Thanks for a long lull; the gate supervisor recorded a concern about departure prep

I need everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to stay sharp on the next wave of companion bookings. We have had steady pressure on handoff details, and the quickest way to keep things calm is to give passengers clear guidance before departure, then keep our own notes tight and visible. When a file looks even a little messy, please flag it right away so the senior coordinator can step in before it reaches the gate.

For the current cases, check each travel folder for pet size, crate fit, and any last touchpoint notes from booking through pickup. <<FACT F057>> If a traveler is bringing a rabbit, keep the animal and crate limit front and center in the file and make sure the guidance is repeated in plain language. <<FACT F064>> Keep the tone kind, direct, and practical, because people tend to panic when they are already rushing.

Also, if you hear a mismatch between what was promised and what the desk has on record, do not wait to sort it alone. Loop in the travel lead, update the checklist, and send the cleaner version back to the passenger contact so the path stays simple. Aurelia Skyways is counting on us to make companion travel feel dependable, and that means we need to catch the small misses before they turn into a boarding problem. Thanks for moving fast and staying careful with each case.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
